And I say it is our solemn responsibility to have as much fun as possible, every waking moment.|Dodibin|}} '''Dodibin''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Suerton]] who resided in [[Canto Bight]] and spent a night, along with his older brother [[Thodibin]] and younger brother [[Wodibin]], [[gambling]] with [[Kaljach Sonmi]]. He went by the nickname '''Dodi'''.
